features.name: Far Traveler
features.description:
At 1st level, the wanderer gains either one additional language known or proficiency in one exotic or martial weapon. At 4th level and every four levels thereafter, the wanderer may gain an additional language known or may retrain her weapon proficiency from this ability to a different exotic or martial weapon.

This ability replaces martial wisdom.

features.name: Ki Pool
features.description:
The wanderer gains additional ki pool points from his Wisdom modifier instead of his Constitution modifier. Additionally, abilities that use his ki pool key off of his Wisdom instead of her Constitution.

This ability modifies ki pool.

features.name: Long Walk
features.description:
At 2nd level, the wanderer gains [Endurance](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/general-feats/endurance/) as a bonus feat, and the feat bonus doubles when he makes Constitution checks because of a forced march. In addition, a wanderer gains a +2 bonus on saving throws against spells and effects that cause exhaustion and fatigue. If the wanderer already has this feat, he may pick another Non-Combat feat for which he must meet the prerequisites for.

This ability replaces ascetic.

features.name: Light Step
features.description:
At 4th level, a wanderer leaves no trail and cannot be tracked, though he can leave a trail if desired. By spending 1 point from his ki pool, he can use *[chocobo haul](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/magic/spells/c/chocobo-haul/),* [*choco feather*](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/magic/spells/c/choco-feather/), [*pass without trace*](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/magic/spells/p/pass-without-trace/), [*quick step*](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/magic/spells/q/quick-step/), or [*wind runner*](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/magic/spells/w/wind-runner/) as a spell-like ability (with a caster level equal to his monk level).

This ability replaces style flexibility.

features.name: Inscrutable
features.description:
At 6th level, the wanderer gains a supernatural air of mystery. The DC to gain information or insight into the wanderer with Diplomacy, Knowledge skills, or Sense Motive increases by 5.

This ability replaces zen.

features.name: Wanderer’s Wisdom
features.description:
At 10th level, the wanderer can dispense excellent advice in the form of philosophical proverbs and parables. As a [swift action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#swift), the wanderer can [inspire courage](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/classes/core-classes/bard/#inspire-courage) or [inspire competence](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/classes/core-classes/bard/#inspire-competence) as a bard of his monk level by spending 1 point from his ki pool. This affects one creature within 30 feet and lasts a number of rounds equal to the wanderer’s Wisdom modifier (minimum 1 round). This ability is language-dependent.

This ability replaces formless strikes.

features.name: Disappear Unnoticed
features.description:
At 13th level, the wanderer may use Stealth to hide even while being directly observed or when no cover or concealment is available, as long as he is adjacent to at least one creature of his size or larger, by spending 1 point from his ki pool. This effect lasts until the beginning of the wanderer’s next turn and may be continued in consecutive rounds by spending 1 ki point each round.

This ability replaces reinforced fortitude.

features.name: Free Step
features.description:
At 17th level, the wanderer gains continuous [*freedom of movement*](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/magic/spells/f/freedom-of-movement/) as a continuous spell-like ability.

This ability replaces fleet footwork.
